purpose: Component height envelopes used by the R25 cross-layer convergence checks. Derived data only: the R22 KiCad board is not modified. XY extents come from the R22 courtyard sizes in SLIM4_R22_PCB_LAYER.json; this table only sets heights above (front) or below (back) the board surface.
rule: height_mm overrides the JSON 'z' value where a manufacturer figure is cited; otherwise the JSON value is kept. Where the JSON value was a placeholder that understated a part (L2), the datasheet value is used. by_value_prefix applies to passives by manufacturer series; any part not listed keeps its JSON height.

D2LS-21.source: Omron D2LS datasheet Cat. No. B122-E1-02, p.1-2 (D2LS-21: 0.6 N, same FP/OP and body as D2LS-11/-21(20M))

B3U-1000P.source: Omron B3U-1000P (3.0 x 2.5 x 1.6 mm); R21 JSON 4.6 mm was a generic placeholder

FH12-20S-0.5SH(55).source: Hirose FH12-20S-0.5SH(55) catalogue: 2.0 mm height, 14.1 x 6.4 mm

SM02B-SRSS-TB(LF)(SN).source: JST SH side-entry header (J3 battery, J4/J5 speakers); R21 JSON value kept (conservative)

USB4105-GF-A-120.source: GCT USB4105 drawing (3.31 mm profile); mating face from the R21 footprint F.Fab outline (0.425 mm beyond the PCB-edge datum line)

ASWPA4035S2R2MT.source: Sunlord ASWPA4035 series: 4.0 x 4.0 x 3.5 mm. R21 JSON listed 1.6 mm, which understates the part

MWSA0402S-1R0MT.source: 4 mm class molded inductor; 2.0 mm used as a conservative envelope (R21 JSON 1.6)

WPN4020H100MT.source: 4020 size code: 4.0 x 4.0 x 2.0 mm (R21 JSON 1.6)

CL21A106KAYNNNE.source: Samsung CL21 0805 MLCC, 1.25 ± 0.1 mm; 0805 maximum thickness class used

front_side_parts_note: Only SW1-SW4 are on the front (F.Cu) side. All other 162 parts are on the back (B.Cu) side.
